europe_now.title: As Europe burns, member states are actually slashing the number of fire-fighters – thanks to EU deficit rules
europe_now.summary: EU deficit rules are being used to justify reductions in firefighter staffing across member states. This cutback happens amid severe wildfire seasons affecting several European regions.

sources.headline: As Europe burns, member states are actually slashing the number of fire-fighters – thanks to EU deficit rules

europe_now.title: Ukraine faces €23B defense funding hole as Western cash comes too slow
europe_now.summary: A substantial defense funding gap has been reported for Ukraine's military operations. Western financial assistance has been delayed, creating a shortfall in sustained support.

sources.headline: Ukraine faces €23B defense funding hole as Western cash comes too slow

top_stories.title: Spain's Sánchez calls national security meeting 26 days into Ceuta migration crisis
top_stories.summary: Spain has convened a national security meeting to address an ongoing migration crisis at Ceuta. The decision follows weeks of sustained pressure at the border crossing.

sources.headline: Spain’s Sánchez calls national security meeting 26 days into Ceuta migration crisis

top_stories.title: Saudi Arabia to invest €6 billion in theme parks near Paris, Macron says
top_stories.summary: Saudi Arabia has pledged a multi-billion euro investment in theme park projects near Paris. French officials describe the deal as part of deepening strategic and economic ties between the two countries.

sources.headline: Saudi Arabia to invest €6 billion in theme parks near Paris, Macron says

top_stories.title: UK, France re-announce anti-missile technology for Ukraine: None will be online for years
top_stories.summary: Britain and France have re-affirmed plans to provide anti-missile technology for Ukraine. Officials note that none of the systems will be operational for several years.

sources.headline: UK, France ‘re-announce’ anti-missile technology for Ukraine: ‘None will be online for years’
